svg.title: The Hyperspace Engine: five nodes and four gates
svg.desc: A left-to-right pipeline of five nodes. gear2-understand exits through check_understanding freezing Problem.md and tests.json; gear3-decide through check_deciding freezing Decision.md, Deferred.md, mapping.json and principles.json; gear4-draft through check_specifying freezing PRD.md, Plan.md and workplan.json; gear5-build through check_executing freezing BUILD_LEDGER.md and RECONCILIATION.md. gear6-live has no exit gate; it is left by confirm, which only a human driver may call. Below the pipeline two parallel tracks show that current_node advances understanding, deciding, specifying, executing and then stops, while status continues to live and then done. The Build gate has four exits: 0 pass, 1 refused, 2 evidence unreadable, 3 HOLD.
svg.text: Five nodes. Four gates. One way through.
is refused outright. live is a
stage you sit in, not a node
the node stops moving; the run does not.

THE BUILD GATE HAS FOUR EXITS
passed and frozen; status becomes live
a row is missing, or claimed done unproven
the required evidence was not supplied
a manual criterion only the human can close
A resumed session re-enters at the node its state file names.
status: live outranks every earlier node, so a finished run never re-enters Build.
